methodology.nifty: NSE Indices public TRI endpoint; TotalReturnsIndex is used (dividends reinvested). NTR retained separately.
methodology.gold: Yahoo Finance adjusted-close proxy for GOLDBEES.NS; not an official benchmark TRI or guaranteed complete NAV history.
methodology.returns: Compute simple/log returns from the level series; do not concatenate unrelated proxy histories without documenting the splice.
methodology.limitations: Undocumented public endpoint and third-party market-data proxy; verify coverage and source terms before publication or production use. No synthetic backfill is created.
